note: endpoint contract design endpoint/hosting contracts 2026-09-11. Paper specification from R11/Appendix B + account security / source research / manifest integration inputs; no provider signup, no provisioning, no device result claimed. Unknown protocol fields are explicit blockers owned by later tasks. Provisioning/verification happens in infrastructure staging; protocol blockers resolve in their owning tasks.

topology.eu_primary: EU (DE) primary hosts all OS endpoints and release origin; TLS terminated on own servers; no CDN at launch.
topology.non_eu_mirror: Independent non-EU mirror (IS candidate) serves identical signed artifacts + proof bundles; clients verify pinned signatures + rollback state; freshness + canonical channel selection monitored; mirror never authenticates first install by itself.
topology.community_separation: Community/federation hosts and credentials are separate from release/update infrastructure . A community-host compromise cannot administer release infrastructure: distinct hosts, distinct credentials, no shared admin path, no release secrets on community hosts.
topology.management_path: Protected management path independent of federation; actual host addresses, management access and secrets are private deployment inputs injected at infrastructure staging provisioning, never stored in this file.

endpoints.consumer_version: pinned at release publication release instance
endpoints.purpose: Signed full/incremental OTA + factory image metadata and bytes for the FP6 port
endpoints.protocol: Existing Updater metadata/verification contract; exact metadata schema, channel selection and proof-bundle verification frozen in release publication from the pinned client.

blocker.description: Exact Updater metadata schema, channel/rollback rules and transparency proof verification must be traced from the pinned Updater client before server behavior is frozen.

endpoints.path_method: TBD from pinned client trace (release publication); replacement serves under releases.diamaneos.de only.
endpoints.verification_root: DiamaneOS release signing keys (ceremony release key ceremony); devices pin release certs + enforce rollback policy; first-install trust via independent AVB fingerprint comparison, never the origin page alone.
endpoints.timeout_retry: Bounded timeouts; transient retry <=3 with backoff; exact values frozen by release publication before activation; never retry-forever.
endpoints.cache_freshness: Immutable artifacts cached indefinitely by hash; channel selection metadata has explicit freshness; stale selection never auto-promotes.
endpoints.failure_fallback: Invalid OTA signature: hard reject. Missing transparency proof: v1 documented warning policy (observation, not prevention). Forbidden downgrade: reject with supported recovery guidance. Offline: signed microSD path (offline signed OTA) through the same trusted pipeline.
endpoints.exposed_data: Device model/version/channel + IP (unavoidable); mirror/CDN-free origin sees request IPs — disclosed on privacy page.
endpoints.retention: Server request logs: none, or <=24h where operationally justified (privacy page states actual).

blocker.description: Bind actual GNSS client protocol, assistance object bounds and freshness rules before freezing cache behavior.

endpoints.path_method: TBD from actual client config (assisted-GNSS integration); egress restricted to the approved Qualcomm upstream only.
endpoints.verification_root: Upstream payload integrity as applicable + freshness policy; expired objects follow documented reject/fallback policy, never false success.
endpoints.timeout_retry: Bounded timeouts; exact values frozen by assisted-GNSS integration.
endpoints.cache_freshness: Cron-refreshed EU cache with checked freshness; expired objects rejected per policy; GPS fallback success alone never proves assistance works.
